=== FIRST ===
Lecture: Lesson 1.5.1: Radial and Transverse Components of Velocity and Acceleration

Section 1: Polar Coordinate System, Position Vector, and Velocity Vector (\\(v_r, v_\theta\\))
- Section Identity: Section 1: Polar Coordinate System, Position Vector, and Velocity Vector (\\(v_r, v_\theta\\))
- Core Understanding: When particle motion is tracked relative to a fixed origin \\(O\\) using radial distance \\(r\\) and angular position \\(\theta\\), polar coordinates \\((r, \theta)\\) provide the natural frame. The unit vector \\(\hat{u}_r\\) extends radially outward along the line of sight from \\(O\\) to particle \\(P\\), while unit vector \\(\hat{u}_\theta\\) points perpendicular to \\(\hat{u}_r\\) in the direction of increasing \\(\theta\\). The position vector is \\(\vec{r} = r\hat{u}_r\\). Taking the time derivative yields velocity \\(\vec{v} = \dot{\vec{r}} = \dot{r}\hat{u}_r + r\dot{\theta}\hat{u}_\theta = v_r\hat{u}_r + v_\theta\hat{u}_\theta\\), where radial velocity \\(v_r = \dot{r} = \frac{dr}{dt}\\) measures the rate of radial extension, and transverse velocity \\(v_\theta = r\dot{\theta} = r\omega\\) measures the rotational velocity perpendicular to the radial arm. Total speed is \\(v = \sqrt{v_r^2 + v_\theta^2}\\).
- Visual-First Explanation: A rotating robotic telescoping arm centered at origin \\(O\\). As particle \\(P\\) slides along the arm while the arm rotates by angle \\(\theta\\), unit vector \\(\hat{u}_r\\) points along the arm length and \\(\hat{u}_\theta\\) points perpendicular to it. The velocity vector decomposes into \\(v_r\\) stretching along the arm and \\(v_\theta\\) pushing tangentially to the rotation.
- Visual Scene Script: A radar station at origin \\(O\\) tracks a flying drone at polar coordinates \\((r, \theta)\\). A radial line \\(r\\) connects origin \\(O\\) to the drone, with unit vector \\(\hat{u}_r\\) pointing outward and unit vector \\(\hat{u}_\theta\\) pointing counterclockwise perpendicular to \\(r\\). As the drone flies, radial velocity arrow \\(v_r = \dot{r}\\) extends/contracts along the radial arm while transverse velocity arrow \\(v_\theta = r\dot{\theta}\\) operates perpendicular to it, adding vectorially to form total velocity \\(\vec{v}\\).
- Dynamic View Blueprint: Interactive polar grid workspace with sliders for radial length \\(r\\), radial rate \\(\dot{r}\\), and angular velocity \\(\dot{\theta}\\), displaying live orthogonal vector components \\(v_r\\) and \\(v_\theta\\) forming speed hypotenuse \\(v\\).
- Visual Learning Outcome: Students visualize polar unit vectors \\((\hat{u}_r, \hat{u}_\theta)\\) and master resolving velocity into radial \\(v_r = \dot{r}\\) and transverse \\(v_\theta = r\dot{\theta}\\) components.
- Concept Check: If a particle moves in a pure circle of constant radius \\(r = C\\), what is its radial velocity component \\(v_r\\)? (Answer: \\(v_r = \dot{r} = 0\\), so total velocity is purely transverse \\(v = v_\theta = r\dot{\theta}\\)).
- Conceptual Summary: In polar coordinates, position is \\(\vec{r} = r\hat{u}_r\\), velocity is \\(\vec{v} = \dot{r}\hat{u}_r + r\dot{\theta}\hat{u}_\theta\\), with radial velocity \\(v_r = \dot{r}\\) and transverse velocity \\(v_\theta = r\dot{\theta}\\).
- شرح للجزء بالعامية المصرية: نظام الإحداثيات القطبية (Polar coordinates \\(r, \theta\\)) بنستخدمه لما تكون الحركة بتتقاس بالنسبة لنقطة أصل ثابتة \\(O\\) بمسافة شعاعية \\(r\\) وزاوية دوران \\(\theta\\). المتجه الذاتي \\(\hat{u}_r\\) طالع برة من نقطة الأصل للجسم، والمتجه \\(\hat{u}_\theta\\) عمودي عليه في اتجاه زيادة الزاوية. متجه السرعة بيتفك لمركبتين متعامدتين: سرعة شعاعية \\(v_r = \dot{r}\\) (معدل تمدد أو انكماش المسافة \\(r\\)) وسرعة عرضية \\(v_\theta = r\dot{\theta}\\) (السرعة الناتجة عن الدوران الزاوي). والسرعة الكلية بتبقى محصلتهم \\(v = \sqrt{v_r^2 + v_\theta^2}\\).
- القوانين (إن وُجدت): \\(\vec{r} = r\hat{u}_r\\), \\(\vec{v} = \dot{r}\hat{u}_r + r\dot{\theta}\hat{u}_\theta = v_r\hat{u}_r + v_\theta\hat{u}_\theta\\), \\(v_r = \dot{r}\\), \\(v_\theta = r\dot{\theta}\\), \\(v = \sqrt{v_r^2 + v_\theta^2}\\)
- إسقاط على مثال أو موقف من الحياة اليومية لتثبيت الفهم: دراع شبكة الرادار البيضاوي وهو بيلف وبيتحدد مكانه ببعد الطيارة ورصد زاويتها، السرعة الشعاعية هي تقارب الطيارة أو ابتعادها عن برج الرادار \\(v_r = \dot{r}\\)، والسرعة العرضية هي حركة الطيارة الدائرية حوالين البرج \\(v_\theta = r\dot{\theta}\\).

Section 2: Acceleration Vector Components in Polar Coordinates (\\(a_r, a_\theta\\))
- Section Identity: Section 2: Acceleration Vector Components in Polar Coordinates (\\(a_r, a_\theta\\))
- Core Understanding: Taking the time derivative of velocity \\(\vec{v} = \dot{r}\hat{u}_r + r\dot{\theta}\hat{u}_\theta\\) accounts for changes in both magnitudes and directions of unit vectors (\\(\dot{\hat{u}}_r = \dot{\theta}\hat{u}_\theta\\) and \\(\dot{\hat{u}}_\theta = -\dot{\theta}\hat{u}_r\\)). This yields total acceleration \\(\vec{a} = a_r\hat{u}_r + a_\theta\hat{u}_\theta\\):
1. Radial Acceleration \\(a_r = \ddot{r} - r\dot{\theta}^2\\): Combines linear radial acceleration \\(\ddot{r}\\) and centripetal acceleration term \\(-r\dot{\theta}^2\\) directed inward toward origin \\(O\\).
2. Transverse Acceleration \\(a_\theta = r\ddot{\theta} + 2\dot{r}\dot{\theta}\\): Combines angular acceleration term \\(r\ddot{\theta}\\) (or \\(r\alpha\\)) and the Coriolis acceleration term \\(2\dot{r}\dot{\theta}\\) resulting from radial motion on a rotating frame.
Total acceleration magnitude is \\(a = \sqrt{a_r^2 + a_\theta^2}\\).
- Visual-First Explanation: A slider moving along a rotating turntable arm. The radial acceleration \\(a_r\\) pulls or pushes along the arm (\\(\ddot{r} - r\dot{\theta}^2\\)). The transverse acceleration \\(a_\theta\\) pushes sideways perpendicular to the arm, featuring a highlighted Coriolis force component \\(2\dot{r}\dot{\theta}\\) that appears whenever the slider moves inward/outward while the table spins.
- Visual Scene Script: A mechanical robot arm rotating at angular speed \\(\dot{\theta}\\) while its extension bar extends at rate \\(\dot{r}\\). Dynamic acceleration vector components appear at the end effector: radial acceleration \\(a_r = \ddot{r} - r\dot{\theta}^2\\) along unit vector \\(\hat{u}_r\\), and transverse acceleration \\(a_\theta = r\ddot{\theta} + 2\dot{r}\dot{\theta}\\) along unit vector \\(\hat{u}_\theta\\). A callout box highlights the Coriolis term \\(2\dot{r}\dot{\theta}\\) expanding as simultaneous radial extension \\(\dot{r}\\) and angular rotation \\(\dot{\theta}\\) increase.
- Dynamic View Blueprint: Interactive dual-motion controller (adjusting \\(\ddot{r}, \dot{r}, \ddot{\theta}, \dot{\theta}\\)) displaying live vector additions for \\(a_r\\) and \\(a_\theta\\), with an isolated Coriolis effect toggle showing \\(2\dot{r}\dot{\theta}\\).
- Visual Learning Outcome: Students comprehend polar acceleration expressions \\(a_r = \ddot{r} - r\dot{\theta}^2\\) and \\(a_\theta = r\ddot{\theta} + 2\dot{r}\dot{\theta}\\), recognizing centripetal and Coriolis contributions.
- Concept Check: What term in the transverse acceleration \\(a_\theta = r\ddot{\theta} + 2\dot{r}\dot{\theta}\\) represents the Coriolis acceleration effect? (Answer: \\(2\dot{r}\dot{\theta}\\), which arises from moving radially on a rotating reference frame).
- Conceptual Summary: Acceleration in polar coordinates is \\(\vec{a} = a_r\hat{u}_r + a_\theta\hat{u}_\theta\\), where \\(a_r = \ddot{r} - r\dot{\theta}^2\\) and \\(a_\theta = r\ddot{\theta} + 2\dot{r}\dot{\theta}\\); \\(a = \sqrt{a_r^2 + a_\theta^2}\\).
- شرح للجزء بالعامية المصرية: لما نشتق متجه السرعة في الإحداثيات القطبية، بنوصل لمتجه العجلة الكلي \\(\vec{a} = a_r\hat{u}_r + a_\theta\hat{u}_\theta\\) اللي بيتكون من مركبتين معقدتين شويه:
1) العجلة الشعاعية \\(a_r = \ddot{r} - r\dot{\theta}^2\\): بتجمع بين التسارع الشعاعي الخطى \\(\ddot{r}\\) والعجلة الجاذبة نحو المركز \\(-r\dot{\theta}^2\\).
2) العجلة العرضية \\(a_\theta = r\ddot{\theta} + 2\dot{r}\dot{\theta}\\): بتجمع بين التسارع الزاوي \\(r\ddot{\theta}\\) وعجلة كوريوليس (Coriolis acceleration) الشهيرة \\(2\dot{r}\dot{\theta}\\) اللي بتظهر لما تكون بتمشي لبرة وجوة في نفس الوقت اللي السيستم بيلف فيه!
والعجلة الكلية هي \\(a = \sqrt{a_r^2 + a_\theta^2}\\).
- القوانين (إن وُجدت): \\(a_r = \ddot{r} - r\dot{\theta}^2\\), \\(a_\theta = r\ddot{\theta} + 2\dot{r}\dot{\theta}\\), \\(\vec{a} = a_r\hat{u}_r + a_\theta\hat{u}_\theta\\), \\(a = \sqrt{a_r^2 + a_\theta^2}\\)
- إسقاط على مثال أو موقف من الحياة اليومية لتثبيت الفهم: لو أنت واقف على لعبة الساقية الدوارة في الملاهي وبدأت تمشي لبرة من المركز للطرف وهي بتلف، هتحس بقوة بتزقك لورا وبترفض حركتك المستقيمة—القوة دي ناتجة عن عجلة كوريوليس العرضية \\(2\dot{r}\dot{\theta}\\).
